gloss: to fit into; to settle down, to be resolved

definitions.gloss: to fit into, to be contained in
definitions.explanation: To fit or be accommodated within a space, container, or limit.

definitions.gloss: to settle down, to subside, to be resolved
definitions.explanation: For a situation, disturbance, or emotion to calm down and return to a normal state.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}がスーツケースに{収|おさ}まった。
examples.english: The luggage fit into the suitcase.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}の{範囲|はんい}に{収|おさ}まるようにした。
examples.english: I made sure it stayed within budget.

examples.japanese: {全部|ぜんぶ}を{一|ひと}つの{箱|はこ}に{収|おさ}めるのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to fit everything in one box.

examples.japanese: {騒|さわ}ぎはすぐに{収|おさ}まった。
{怒|いか}りが{収|おさ}まらない。
{話|はなし}し{合|あ}いで{丸|まる}く{収|おさ}まった。
examples.english: It was resolved amicably through discussion.

notes:
The transitive counterpart is {収|おさ}める (to put in, to store; to bring under control). The kanji {収|おさ}まる focuses on containment and resolution, while the homophone {治|おさ}まる focuses on governance or healing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{丸|まる}く{収|おさ}まる — to be resolved amicably
・{怒|いか}りが{収|おさ}まる — anger subsides
・{騒|さわ}ぎが{収|おさ}まる — commotion dies down
・{予算|よさん}に{収|おさ}まる — to stay within budget

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{治|おさ}まる — to be governed; to heal, to be cured
・{納|おさ}まる — to be delivered, to be paid
